findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "wintraits_diagnosticar_producto" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Why isn't my product selling? What should I change in my Amazon listing? (¿Por qué no vende mi producto? ¿Qué cambio en mi ficha de Amazon?) Diagnoses a product…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wintraits_opinion · Public sink: wintraits_atributos_ganadores, wintraits_panorama_categoria, wintraits_opciones_concepto.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wintraits_opinion · Public sink: wintraits_atributos_ganadores, wintraits_panorama_categoria, wintraits_opciones_concepto

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
